title: Visual Design Apprentice
description:
Visual Design Apprentice


The Short Version
You make things beautiful. Not “clean and modern” beautiful. Stop-scrolling, zoom-in, who-made-this beautiful. You'll design the visual identity systems, product interfaces, and brand assets for ventures that don't exist yet.


What Liminal Is
A Founders' Studio. We co-build with repeat founders, many of them unicorn founders, providing build expertise, capital, and unfair access from founding to Series B. We call ourselves a Founders' Studio because “venture studio” undersells what we do and oversells what most of them deliver.


What This Role Actually Is
Dirty secret in design hiring: the Venn of great visual and great UX designers barely overlaps. We hire for the visual circle. Emphatically.


You build the visual layer for a venture: identity, interfaces, decks, assets. You turn positioning into something a founder looks at and says "that's us." You sweat what others don't see. Optical alignment. The weight of whitespace. Why one shade of blue reads "trustworthy fintech" and the one three hex values over reads "dental office."


The Work

- Visual identity and brand systems. Translate brand strategy into complete visual identities: typography, color, layout grids, iconography, the overall look and feel that makes a venture cohesive across every touchpoint.
- Product and digital surfaces. Design clean, visually engaging UI for early-stage products: landing pages, dashboards, onboarding flows, marketing pages. You own the high-fidelity output and work directly with engineering so what ships looks like what you designed.
- Brand assets at scale. Decks, social content, one-pagers, investor materials, event collateral. Often the first thing the outside world sees. They need to be flawless.
- Design system stewardship. Build and maintain coherent design languages that hold up as the venture grows, so the hundredth asset looks as considered as the first.


Who You Are

- Exceptional visual craft. A portfolio that makes us lean in. Strong command of typography, color theory, composition, and layout across brand and digital surfaces. You know the difference between beautiful and merely pretty. You can explain why, in terms that aren't just vibes.
- Exquisite taste. Omnivorous and opinionated. You have feelings about restaurant menus, movie title sequences, transit signage, and the packaging on your toothpaste. Your taste is informed by what you've consumed across design, art, architecture, fashion, and culture. Not just what Dribbble served you last week.
- Tool fluency. Figma and Adobe Creative Suite are second nature. You work fast, iterate without preciousness, and produce high-fidelity output that doesn't need a translator between you and engineering.
- Comfort with ambiguity. No brand guides. No existing design systems. No “make it like the last one.” A founder, a blank page, and a company that needs to look like it was inevitable. That should thrill you.
- Contrarian streak. Independent thinker. Arg

Olive Ateliers is a design house built on one conviction: the objects worth living with are the ones worth leaving behind. Founded in Los Angeles in 2021, we work at the intersection of two practices. Discovery: sourcing one-of-a-kind antiques and rare vintage from around the world. Design: three to four original collections a year, built around a place, a muse, or a way of living, made by artisans and engineered to last generations.


The work is for the person who chooses patina over polish, lineage over launch hype, rituals over trends. Featured in Vogue, The New York Times, Architectural Digest, and ELLE Decor, in conversation with Jacquemus, Loewe, Burberry, and Aimé Leon Dore, the brand reaches a community of more than 800,000. title: UI/UX Product Designer - AI Trainer
description:
About The Job

We are looking for an existing UI/UX Product Designer to help train AI models. You will measure the progress of these AI chatbots, evaluate their logic, and solve problems to improve the quality of each model.

In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers.

This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables).

Advantages Of Contracting With Us



- You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
- You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
- General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with higher bonus rates available for certain projects

Responsibilities



- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals
- Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance
- Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design

Qualifications



- Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
- Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design
- Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow
- Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice
- A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

title: Designer, Web Presence & Platform
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Web Presence & Platform (WPP) is organized into two pillars—Platform and Presence. The Platform pillar builds internal systems, tooling, and infrastructure to support the web. The Presence pillar owns the public-facing storytelling across stripe.com and link.com—including our homepage, product landing pages, industry and solutions pages, and other high-impact go-to-market surfaces. Together, we shape how millions of people understand what Stripe is and what it can do for them.

Designers on the Presence team work at the intersection of craft and impact—balancing clarity, polish, and systems thinking with strategic storytelling and experimentation. We collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, content, and product to deliver work that is not only beautiful, but measurably moves the business.

What you'll do

As a Designer on the Presence team, you'll own design across two distinct and high-visibility surface areas—Link (the Stripe one-click checkout experience and link.com) and Bridge (bridge.xyz—the Stripe stablecoin financial infrastructure, operating as its own standalone web property). These are some of the most strategically varied and creatively demanding surfaces in our portfolio—each with its own audience, brand voice, and design challenge.

You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy—driving work from brief to launch, navigating ambiguity with confidence, and setting the quality bar for your focus areas. You'll shape the design systems and storytelling frameworks that make these surfaces scale, and you'll build deep expertise that makes you a go-to partner for the cross-functional teams you work alongside. This is a high-ownership role for a designer who is equally at home leading a complex project and sweating the details of a single layout.

Responsibilities



- Own the end-to-end design of your focus areas, Link and Bridge, from early strategy through final delivery, with minimal oversight
- Drive clarity in ambiguous or loosely defined briefs by synthesizing user needs, business goals, and technical constraints into a coherent point of view
- Lead cross-functional collaboration with engineering, PMM, content design, brand, and product—facilitating alignment, integrating feedback, and keeping projects moving
- Partner deeply with engineering throughout the design process, from exploring technical possibilities and constraints early, to co-creating solutions at the intersection of craft and code

- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals

description:

- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals

- Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice
- A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required

title: UI Designer - AI Neobank App (US)
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a UI Designer to craft intuitive, elegant and high-performing interfaces for BJAK's AI and financial products.

This role is for someone who obsesses over visual quality, interaction details and usability. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to design mobile-first experiences that make complex financial products feel simple, trustworthy and enjoyable to use.

What You'll Own



- Design polished, user-centric interfaces for mobile and web products. 
- Transform product requirements into wireframes, user flows, prototypes and high-fidelity UI. 
- Build intuitive experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and other financial services. 
- Maintain and evolve BJAK's design system to ensure consistency across products. 
- Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to deliver pixel-perfect implementation. 
- Iterate designs using user feedback, analytics and usability testing. 
- Ensure accessibility, responsiveness and visual consistency across different devices and platforms. 
- Contribute to improving overall product usability, interaction patterns and visual language. 

What We're Looking For



- 2–5 years of experience designing digital products, with a strong focus on mobile applications. 
- Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design, interaction design and UI craftsmanship. 
- Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and modern design workflows. 
- Strong understanding of mobile-first design principles, platform guidelines (iOS & Android) and responsive layouts. 
- Good understanding of UX principles, information architecture and user-centred design. 
- Ability to simplify complex user journeys into intuitive interfaces. 
- High attention to detail with strong visual hierarchy, typography and spacing. 
- Portfolio is required. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

title: Senior Product Designer, Bee
description:
Description

Help define a new category of ambient AI from the ground up. Bee is building a wearable that listens to your day and turns everyday context into a personal AI and we need a Senior Product Designer to help shape what this becomes.

You'll design cross-device experiences that span Bee's core product and broader ecosystems, defining interaction models for ambient, context-aware computing. This is a rare opportunity to work on a 0-to-1 product with a small, senior team where you'll have high ownership, startup pace and Amazon scale.

Key job responsibilities



-  Design end-to-end experiences across Bee's mobile app, wearable hardware and integrations with third-party ecosystems (Amazon Alexa, Apple Watch, smart home devices, and more)
-  Define and prototype interaction models for ambient, always-listening AI, solving for privacy, context-awareness, and seamless multi-surface experiences
-  Own the design process from concept to launch: research, wireframes, high-fidelity mocks, prototypes
-  Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and leadership to balance user needs, business goals, technical constraints and a high craft bar
-  Move fast and iterate in a high-ambiguity environment, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and learning through shipping
-  Establish and evolve design systems and patterns that scale across Bee's growing product ecosystem

About The Team

We're a small, senior team building a new category of ambient AI that lives with you throughout your day. Think early days energy with the resources and distribution of Amazon behind us.

The team is intentionally lean. Everyone owns significant pieces of the product, and you'll work directly with engineers and product leaders daily. Decisions happen in hours, not weeks. We prototype fast, ship often, and learn by putting things in people's hands (and on their wrists).

Basic Qualifications



-  6+ years of UX designer or interaction designer experience
-  Experience designing and prototyping with tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar
-  Experience creating, improving and executing engagement programs and action plans
-  High craft bar and strong systems thinking

Preferred Qualifications



-  Experience across both startups and larger company ecosystems
-  Background in wearables, smart home, voice, hardware-software, or ambient computing
-  Can spike in either motion, prototyping or both

Embrace your passion for innovation as a Product Designer, playing a pivotal role in advancing Esri's flagship mobile app, ArcGIS Field Maps, on iOS and Android. title: Digital Product Designer - AI Trainer
description:
About The Job

We are looking for an existing Digital Product Designer to help train AI models. You will measure the progress of these AI chatbots, evaluate their logic, and solve problems to improve the quality of each model.

In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers.

This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables).

Advantages Of Contracting With Us



- You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
- You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
- General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with higher bonus rates available for certain projects

Responsibilities



- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals
- Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance
- Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design

Qualifications



- Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
- Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design
- Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow
- Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice
- A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to create consumer-facing experiences on web and mobile that serve as the front door to our real estate platform — the point at which home buyers and sellers first encounter our brands, begin their search, and get connected with the professionals who will guide them. In this role, you will partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to design experiences that work across a portfolio of real estate brands, helping consumers find what they need and take their next step with confidence.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience designing within consumer brand ecosystems across web and mobile platforms, a rigorous approach to discovery and research, and a portfolio that demonstrates both design excellence and user-centric thinking. You are highly collaborative, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and motivated by the challenge of making something genuinely difficult feel clear and human.

- Lead and support discovery work to understand consumer behaviors, mental models, and pain points across the home search and agent-connection journey. title: Product Design Manager, Design Systems
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is looking for a Design Systems Manager to join Design Foundations, the infrastructure layer of Lyft's design organization. Design Systems at Lyft is an integral part of the overall user experience. Our design system spans product surfaces, marketing, and brand, officially known as the Lyft Product Language (LPL) and shipped directly to code. You'll own the craft and execution of that system, partner closely with design, engineering, and marketing, and lead Design systems work through a period of active global growth and capability expansion.

This role reports to the Director of Design Foundations and works alongside a dedicated DPM and Engineering managers, and a tight-knit team of design systems practitioners.

Responsibilities:

Strategy & Vision



- Set the strategy and roadmap for Lyft Product Language (LPL) across product, marketing, and brand surfaces, in partnership with the Director of Design Foundations and engineering leadership and the Design Systems team
- Lead the AI transformation of the system: integrate AI into LPL tooling, adoption workflows, and the day-to-day designer experience at Lyft
- Represent Design Systems in reviews and other senior leadership forums

People & Craft



- Manage and develop a team of design systems designers and illustrators working across iOS, Android, web, and brand
- Hold the quality bar for system-wide design: cross-platform coherence, accessibility (WCAG), road safety, localization, and brand consistency.
- Coach the team on making educated tradeoffs between flexibility, coherency, usability, and efficiency

Execution & Partnership



- Partner closely with the Design Systems DPM and engineering managers to maintain system health, sequence work, and unblock teams
- Own the LPL component contribution and review process end-to-end, from intake through release
- Communicate system decisions, adoption expectations, and quality standards upward and across product, engineering, and marketing

Experience:



- 7+ years in product or brand design, including 2+ years managing designers
- Direct experience leading a design system at scale: components, patterns, guidelines, and shipped-to-code workflows
- Fluency across mobile and web platforms, with a working understanding of how systems are consumed by engineers
- Experience managing a design systems team
- Strong track record of partnership with engineering on architecture, releases, and quality
- Experience setting and defending craft standards across cross-functional stakeholders
- Familiarity with AI-assisted design tooling (Figma MCP, generative workflows, agentic prototyping) is a strong plus
- Excellent written communication; comfortable operating in an async-heavy environment with documented decisions
- Comfortable driving disagree-and-commit decisions and making

title: Contract Production Designer
description:
What we offer

Design for a better world. As a designer, you will craft fresh, delightful, people-centered experiences across web, mobile, email, social, and print. Working with a mix of nonprofits, brands, and causes, you will build cohesive, action-oriented campaigns, craft responsive websites and brands, and engage audiences with compelling visual storytelling. You’ll work on an interdisciplinary team of strategists, writers, analysts, web developers, creative directors, and clients.

The Company 

Blue State is a purpose-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London.

The Team

Designers at Blue State are curious, passionate, and eager to collaborate across disciplines. They’re thoroughly immersed in the field of design and are able to work quickly, autonomously, and with polish. They understand how to use design to provoke action, aid in understanding, and clarify information.

A day in the life



- Support the visual design of a wide range of projects – including email and social campaigns, Direct Mail and Paid Media. 
- Collaborate with writers, other designers and creative directors to iterate and evolve designs based on feedback.

The hourly rate for this position is $30.

Some things we're looking for



- 1-2 years of experience minimum
- Flexible skills: We’re looking for a versatile design aesthetic, and brilliant examples of how to reach and activate audiences across different styles and platforms online. Prior experience in Figma , After Effects and designing for digital platforms (Social + Paid ads and email) is preferred.
- Ability to adapt to new situations, solve problems on the fly, and communicate with those around you. Teamwork and scrappiness required.
- Passion for progress. This includes comfort with ambiguity, a restlessness that resists the status quo, and a commitment to quality that ensures we’re always moving forward.
- Empathy, communication, respect, and the ability to act as a role model at Blue State

At Blue State, diversity is a necessity, not a nice-to-have. title: Visual Learning Designer
description:
At VF, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness, and authenticity. So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture - visit VF Careers or www.vfc.com.

What will you do?

A day in the life of a Visual Learning Designer / Instructional Graphic Designer at VF looks a little like this.

You work within Global Learning and Leadership Development as part of the enterprise learning design team. You partner closely with Learning Experience Designers, facilitators, and program partners across global and regional teams. Your role focuses on translating learning intent into clear, consistent, and accessible visual design by creating templates, visual systems, and reusable assets that support understanding, navigation, and facilitation across enterprise learning experiences. This role reports to the Manager, Learning Experience Design.

Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.

- Responsible for applying and maintaining the visual look and feel of learning materials across programs, platforms, and regions in alignment with established learning design standards. 
- Ensure enterprise learning materials are visually coherent, clear, and easy to navigate so experiences feel connected and intentional. 

Template Architecture & Reusable Assets



- Design and maintain learning‑specific templates, visual standards, and reusable asset libraries to support consistent, high‑quality learning design. 
- Enable efficiency and scalability by making visual design standards easy for learning teams to use and apply. 

Clarity, Accessibility & Cognitive Load Reduction



- Apply learning and accessibility standards to reduce cognitive load, improve comprehension, and support inclusive learning experiences. 
- Ensure learning materials are readable, usable, and accessible across formats, audiences, and delivery contexts. 

Design Partnership & Early Integration



- Partner closely with Learning Experience Designers during the design process to translate experience intent into clear and effective visual structure. 
- Convert complex models, frameworks, and concepts into intuitive diagrams, layouts, and visual learning assets that support understanding and facilitation. 

Sustained Visual Quality & Evolution



- Maintain and refine visual standards, templates, and assets over time based on learner, facilitator, and designer feedback. 
- Contribute to continuous improvement of the learning visual system to support evolving learning needs and platforms. 

What do you need to succeed?

We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundation skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. title: Surface Designer
description:
About the Company
Since 2008, EnVogue International has been a leader in trend-driven home décor, partnering with major retailers across North America to bring innovative products from concept to shelf. Through a collaborative design process and an established global manufacturing network, we develop high-quality products across a diverse portfolio that includes bedding, decorative pillows, kitchen linen, rugs, bath accessories, home fragrance, stationery, furniture, tabletop, and more.


About the Role
As we continue to grow, we're expanding our team with talented professionals who are passionate about product, retail, and building strong partnerships. At EnVogue International, employees have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, collaborate across functions, and help shape the future of a dynamic and evolving organization.


As the Surface Designer (Home & Lifestyle), you will develop original prints, patterns, and graphics applied across EnVogue’s hard goods and lifestyle categories, including home décor, tabletop, lawn & garden, travel accessories, stationery, and paper goods. This hands-on creative role focuses on translating flat artwork and surface concepts onto physical products.


You will collaborate closely with Product Development and global vendor partners to deliver trend-forward print collections and clean CAD mappings for production.


Responsibilities

- Research and translate global lifestyle trends into cohesive print collections, seasonal color palettes, and mood boards.
- Design original illustrations, placement graphics, and seamless repeat patterns tailored for hard goods and lifestyle items.
- Create detailed CADs, artwork scale specs, and colorways for product presentation and manufacturing.
- Build production-ready artwork files, specifying mechanical layouts, repeats, color separations, and print finishes (such as foils or decals) for vendor execution.
- Apply technical knowledge of surface print methods to map 2D artwork accurately onto diverse non-textile materials like ceramic, glass, metal, wood, and paper.
- Maintain an organized surface artwork library and seasonal CAD archive.


Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Surface Design, Graphic Design, Textile Design, Fine Arts, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience in surface pattern, print, or graphic design for home décor, tabletop, stationery, or lifestyle products.
- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator), with strong expertise in creating CADs, pattern repeats, color separations, and product mappings.
- Strong understanding of color theory, typography, print trends, and surface artwork placement.
- Solid grasp of artwork setup for vendor production across various hard substrates.
- Please include a portfolio link or attachment showcasing surface patterns, graphics, and CAD/product mappings with your application.

From concept development and fabric selection to sampling and production, we manage the complete product development process with a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and timely delivery. Our client is seeking a creative and detail-oriented Freelance Women's Dresses Designer to join their team for an ongoing in-office assignment.

Salary/Hourly Rate

$35/hr

Position Overview

The Freelance Women's Dresses Designer will support the design and development of women's dress collections from concept through production. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in women's western wear design, garment development, and PLM systems, along with excellent graphic presentation skills.

- Design seasonal and commercial collections for women's dresses.
- Develop creative concepts, mood boards, color palettes, and fabric stories.

Required Experience/Skills For The Freelance Women's Dresses Designer

- Good understanding of garment construction, fabrics, trims, and fit.
- Ability to create technical sketches, tech packs, and production-ready artwork.

Education Requirements

title: Product UI Designer - AI Trainer
description:
About The Job

We are looking for an existing Product UI Designer to help train AI models. You will measure the progress of these AI chatbots, evaluate their logic, and solve problems to improve the quality of each model.

In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers.

This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables).

Advantages Of Contracting With Us



- You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
- You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
- General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with higher bonus rates available for certain projects

Responsibilities



- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals
- Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance
- Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design

Qualifications



- Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
- Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design
- Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow
- Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice
- A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

Strong understanding of typography, layout, color theory, visual hierarchy, branding, and design principles. Odin is building infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should be putting it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.


Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legals and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.


We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.


Mission
We’re looking for a senior design leader who combines exceptional visual craft with systems-level product thinking. You’ll play a central role in defining and elevating the customer experience at Odin as we prepare for a major US launch.


The scope here is intentionally broad. Your remit spans across product and visual brand identity. You’ll help evolve our brand identity alongside the founders, expressing the philosophy, ambition and cultural stance of a company that is rethinking what progress means and how we get there.


Working with our existing designer, our Head of Product and the wider product team, you’ll help set the design direction for the company, raise the quality bar and shape how design operates as we grow. You’ll bring experience and conviction to make strong design decisions quickly, while creating the systems, practices and feedback loops that allow consistently excellent work to scale.


You’ll remain close to the work: exploring complex problems, building and testing prototypes, speaking directly with customers and translating what you learn into polished, production-ready experiences. You won’t be stepping into a finished structure. You’ll be helping to shape the next stage of it.


Your remit spans both product and brand. You’ll turn complex, regulation-heavy workflows and dense interfaces into experiences that feel clear, intuitive and inevitable.


Your Must-Have Qualities
We value designers who combine rigorous reasoning, high agency, exceptional craft and deep customer empathy. You’ll succeed in this role if you are:

- Deeply user-centric: You advocate for the customer and care about how people experience the product. You use interviews, data and observation to understand real behaviour—not just what users say.
- Exceptional in your craft: You have a highly developed eye for composition, hierarchy, interaction and detail. You create polished, cohesive experiences and hold the shipped product to a very high standard.

- You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when

- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals

We are on a mission to revolutionize employment by building the infrastructure that powers every facet of work . To do this, we're looking for individuals who think about problems holistically and in-depth, who are relentlessly curious, self-starters, and determined to drive ideas from inception through to completion.

Finch is a Series B company backed by a fantastic set of firms, angels, and our developers including General Catalyst, Menlo Ventures, Homebrew, BoxGroup, YCombinator, Charley (1st business hire at Plaid), Sima (ex-Head of Biz Dev at Plaid), Henrique + Pedro (co-CEOs at Brex), Jeff + Wayne (co-CEOs at Digits), Immad (CEO at Mercury), Sam (CEO at Vouch Insurance), Karim (CTO at Ramp), and more.

Everyone on the team is excited about the scope of the problems we address and the potential impact our work can have on the global workforce. We realize that the value we provide comes with great responsibilities, and therefore make security and privacy our highest priorities.

description:
About The Job

We are looking for an existing UX/Product Designer to help train AI models. You will measure the progress of these AI chatbots, evaluate their logic, and solve problems to improve the quality of each model.

In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers.

This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables).

Advantages Of Contracting With Us



- You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
- You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
- General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with higher bonus rates available for certain projects

Responsibilities



- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals
- Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance
- Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design

Qualifications



- Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
- Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design
- Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow
- Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice
- A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

Sage is on a mission to improve care and quality of life for older adults, starting with those residing in senior living facilities. Falls are the leading cause of injury-related death among adults over 65. And yet, fall prevention and emergency response systems for older adults are archaic and ineffective. At Sage we've built a more modern way of understanding when older adults need help, including methods for residents to alert caregivers when in need of help, and corresponding software for caregivers to triage response. Our company mission is to create a product that our client counterparts love, and this role is a key part of that objective.

Sage is a small, tight team of ambitious, multi-disciplinary entrepreneurs. We are a software-enabled, mission-driven company, and are focused only on the problems that are central to achieving that mission.
